labels.community_standard_fit: Reviewer invokes expected baselines, benchmarks, reporting norms, or field standards.
labels.credibility_trust: Reviewer questions whether claims are trustworthy or adequately supported.
labels.ethical_or_social_risk: Reviewer raises ethics, bias, privacy, safety, or societal risk.
labels.evidence_chain_stability: Reviewer questions whether figures, statistics, methods, and claims form a stable evidence chain.
labels.methodological_maturity: Reviewer questions whether the method is sufficiently mature, robust, or justified.
labels.novelty_positioning: Reviewer questions whether contribution is meaningfully new or well positioned.
labels.presentation_as_epistemic_signal: Reviewer treats presentation clarity as a signal of evidential reliability.
labels.reproducibility_expectation: Reviewer expects code, data, parameters, protocols, or reporting details.
labels.scope_and_claim_boundary: Reviewer questions whether claims exceed the evidence or context.
labels.unknown: No reliable tacit concern can be inferred from observable text.
